prompted_for: A situation router instead of a 4-column table (became Router: situations on the left, one route through water, system and first step)
composition: two near-identical variants stacked vertically, each a full section on deep navy
small mono eyebrow '03 // SITUATION ROUTER' above a large bold sentence-case question
left column: five numbered situation rows, one selected and highlighted
right: three framed stations in a row (target water grade, recommended system, first step), numbered 1-3
a single thin pipe line leaves the selected row and routes through the stations to the action
layout_devices: numbered list rows with large faded numerals
selected row filled with steel-blue tint plus a 'SELECTED' pill and a node dot
pipe route line with valve symbols, a pump/flow symbol and arrowheads connecting stations
station frames with small mono 'STATION 01' labels
small schematic drawing of tanks and columns inside the system station
limit chips in light boxes (CFU, TOC)
filled steel-blue action box at the route end
tiny title-block style annotations at frame corners
palette: steel-blue selection fill, route line and action box
pale chip backgrounds with dark text
typography: mono caps eyebrow with double slash
small mono station labels and annotations
bold sans grade name in station
ui_patterns: top nav with underline active state
motion_implied: water travels the pipe from the chosen row to the action
stations swap content when a new situation is selected
t2i_keywords: numbered list rows on the left
selected row with steel-blue highlight and pill badge
three framed stations in a row
small schematic line drawing of tanks and columns
t2i_prompt: Flat UI mockup, no device frame, of an interactive section for <CONTENT> on a deep navy ground. A mono uppercase eyebrow and a large bold sentence-case question. Left: numbered option rows with large faded numerals, one selected with a steel-blue tint, a small pill badge and a node dot. From it a single thin pipe route with valve and pump symbols and arrowheads runs through three framed stations labelled with small mono numbers: a result with limit chips, a small schematic line drawing of tanks and columns, and a filled steel-blue action box. 1 px light-blue lines, off-white text, square corners, no shadows.
signature_idea: Pick your situation and one pipe carries you through the water grade, the system and the first step.
strengths: turns a table into a guided decision, ideal for buyers who start from different places
pipe-route metaphor is native to Aquemi's product
clear selected state and single call to action
navy plus steel-blue accent on palette
weaknesses: bold geometric headline is heavier than Geist light
station frames carry illegible annotation noise
two near-duplicate variants make the image redundant
small schematic inside station is too tiny to read
brand_fit_why: Navy ground, single steel-blue accent, square corners and mono labels fit; the bold headline and corner noise drift from calm, light Geist.
